text.formula: A wheel with teeth rolls inside a ring with teeth
A pen in one hole of the wheel draws
The drawing has 16 petals and closes after 5 turns
A hole nearer the centre: smoother
On the rim: sharp points

text.formula: 96 and 30: 16 petals, 5 turns
96 and 32: 3 petals, 1 turn
96 and 42: 16 petals, 7 turns
96 and 63: 32 petals, 21 turns
Golden ratio: it never closes

youtube.title: The teeth decide the shape: petals and turns 🔢 #shorts
youtube.description:
Petals = R ÷ gcd(R, r). Turns = r ÷ gcd(R, r). A ratio that is not a fraction never closes.

text.formula: Close to the centre: nearly a circle
Halfway: gentle waves
Near the edge: deep loops
On the edge: sharp points (a hypocycloid)
Beyond the edge: knots

Around a disk: loops point outward
Equal circles: a cardioid
Half the size: a nephroid
